#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fake Claude-shaped harness for tmux lifecycle tests."""
import os
import select
import sys
import termios
import time
import tty

RULE = "─" * 40
IDLE = "  ⏵⏵ auto mode on"
BUSY = "  ⏵⏵ auto mode on · esc to interrupt"

transcript = ["fake harness ready"]
composer = ""
working_until = None


def draw():
    global working_until
    working = working_until is not None and time.monotonic() < working_until
    rows = transcript[-10:] + [RULE, "❯ " + composer, RULE, BUSY if working else IDLE]
    out = "\x1b[H\x1b[2J" + "\r\n".join(rows) + "\r\n"
    os.write(1, out.encode())


def submit(prompt):
    global working_until, composer
    composer = ""
    # agentctl send opens every prompt with a sender header line, which a paste joins to the
    # body with a space; the fake acts on the body, as an agent reads past the header.
    text = prompt
    if text.startswith("[from ") and "] " in text:
        text = text.split("] ", 1)[1]
    if text == "die-now":
        draw()
        raise SystemExit(0)
    transcript.append("❯ " + prompt)
    if text == "finish-now":
        working_until = None
        transcript.append("• finished")
    elif text == "spawn-child":
        import subprocess

        command = os.environ.get("FAKE_SPAWN_CMD") or "__SPAWN_CMD__"
        if command:
            subprocess.Popen(
                ["/bin/sh", "-c", command],
                stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            )
        transcript.append("• spawned")
    elif text.startswith("work:"):
        seconds = 4.0
        rest = text[5:].strip()
        head = rest.split()[0] if rest else ""
        try:
            seconds = float(head)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        working_until = time.monotonic() + seconds
        transcript.append("• Working")
    elif working_until is not None and time.monotonic() < working_until:
        transcript.append("queued: " + text)
    else:
        transcript.append("• done: " + text)
    draw()


def main():
    global composer, working_until
    argv_file = "__ARGV_FILE__"
    if not argv_file.startswith("__"):
        with open(argv_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(" ".join(sys.argv[1:]) + "\n")
    fd = sys.stdin.fileno()
    old = termios.tcgetattr(fd)
    tty.setraw(fd)
    os.write(1, b"\x1b[?2004h")
    buf = b""
    paste = False
    try:
        draw()
        while True:
            timeout = 0.1
            ready, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], timeout)
            now = time.monotonic()
            if working_until is not None and now >= working_until:
                working_until = None
                transcript.append("• finished")
                draw()
            if not ready:
                continue
            chunk = os.read(fd, 65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            buf += chunk
            while buf:
                if buf.startswith(b"\x1b[200~"):
                    paste = True
                    buf = buf[6:]
                    continue
                if buf.startswith(b"\x1b[201~"):
                    paste = False
                    buf = buf[6:]
                    draw()
                    continue
                if buf.startswith(b"\x1b"):
                    # Skip one escape sequence - [ up to a final byte.
                    if len(buf) < 2:
                        break
                    if buf[1:2] == b"[":
                        end = None
                        for i in range(2, min(len(buf), 16)):
                            if 0x40 <= buf[i] <= 0x7E:
                                end = i + 1
                                break
                        if end is None:
                            break
                        buf = buf[end:]
                    else:
                        buf = buf[2:]
                    continue
                byte = buf[0]
                buf = buf[1:]
                if byte in (13, 10) and not paste:
                    submit(composer)
                elif byte in (13, 10) and paste:
                    composer += " "
                elif byte == 127 or byte == 8:
                    composer = composer[:-1]
                    draw()
                elif byte == 3:
                    composer = ""
                    working_until = None
                    draw()
                elif byte >= 32:
                    # take one utf-8 char
                    text = bytes([byte])
                    while True:
                        try:
                            char = text.decode()
                            break
                        except UnicodeDecodeError:
                            if not buf:
                                char = ""
                                break
                            text += bytes([buf[0]])
                            buf = buf[1:]
                    composer += char
                    if not paste:
                        draw()
    finally:
        termios.tcsetattr(fd, termios.TCSADRAIN, old)
        os.write(1, b"\x1b[?2004l\r\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
